title: BEN Wallet
description: Wallet recovery and the inheritance aspect of the wallet is a critical aspect to provide security and convenience for anyone in the crypto space. But this is challenging with the existing mechanism as most of the EOA wallets are not well suited to solve this problem and they are limited to the capabilities of the protocol implementations. With the help of the account abstraction concept whole lot of opportunities are created where we can make the recovery and inheritance aspect much more secure and convenient. With BEN Wallet we are trying to solve this very own problem.
how_its_made: Bootsrapping the account abstraction project was a bit harder than anticipated as we had to set up our own local infrastructure. We also encountered a few dependency issues while integrating the browser plugin with the SDK.
